items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: But I happen to remember seeing her one time when they came to Baton Rouge on a medicine show.

ctx.x: What medicine show was she with?

I don't know. I think it was... They had another show called Eddie Lee's Elixir that she was in, I think. I don't know; it was something. But I happen to remember seeing her one time when they came to Baton Rouge on a medicine show. A lot of medicine shows came to Baton Rouge...
How many different medicine shows would you say there were at this time?
